\section{Human--computer interaction design (reusable for the HMI mini-project)}

\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Fitts's law:} the panel opens next to the selection; commands are one click away; the toolbar moves away from the cursor.
\item \textbf{Hick's law:} a few pinned commands in the toolbars, the full set in the panel.
\item \textbf{Immediate feedback:} the overlay is on screen in milliseconds; a status chain shows recognising text, uploading, streaming and finished timing.
\item \textbf{Error prevention and recovery:} undo and redo, Escape everywhere, Retry, Stop, and a notice before anything is sent.
\item \textbf{User control:} pin, collapse, local-only mode, choose whether the image or only the text is sent, choose which models and shortcuts appear.
\item \textbf{Does not steal focus:} commands run without taking the keyboard from the application being read.
\end{itemize}

Usability test plan (5--8 participants): three tasks (explain an error message, compare two charts, translate a paragraph), each done the manual way (screenshot \ensuremath{\rightarrow} chatbot \ensuremath{\rightarrow} paste \ensuremath{\rightarrow} type) and with IntelliPointer. Record completion time, errors and a System Usability Scale questionnaire. SUS score = 2.5 \ensuremath{\times} (\ensuremath{\Sigma}(odd item - 1) + \ensuremath{\Sigma}(5 - even item)); above 68 is above average.

\section{Register of experiments}\label{sec:experiments}

Every experiment, test and measurement carried out on IntelliPointer AI, by name. \textquotedbl{}Pass\textquotedbl{} means the automated check passed in the final run (\texttt{npm run test:\allowbreak{}all} in \texttt{backend/\allowbreak{}}, \texttt{npm test} and the \texttt{test/\allowbreak{}*.\allowbreak{}e2e.\allowbreak{}js} suites in \texttt{desktop/\allowbreak{}}). Measured values are from a 1920\ensuremath{\times}1080 display at 125 \% scaling.
